title: The Inventor's Junk Drawer
skyStory: The moon swaggers into Aquarius, mostly full and wearing goggles pushed up on its forehead. It has invented seven gadgets since breakfast and none of them have a clear purpose. Uranus, the ruler of Aquarius, keeps handing it spare parts from the far edge of the solar system. Saturn has asked twice what the blinking one does. Nobody knows. It blinks anyway.

reading: Aquarius flips your usual approach upside down. The way you always do it is not the only way, and today you will stumble onto a weird shortcut that works beautifully. Maybe you hold the screwdriver differently. Maybe you write the email backwards, ending first. The Tiger tilts its head and grins.

Saturday afternoon is perfect for tinkering. Take something apart that is already broken and see if you can make it do something new. A lamp that becomes a planter. A box that becomes a shelf. The [[Page of Wands]] is cheering from the doorway, holding a sprouting stick like a trophy, and he is extremely loud about it.
joel.mission: Do one ordinary task in a completely different order than usual and decide whether the new way wins.
joel.omen: A machine making a strange new noise that turns out to be harmless. Your odd idea is actually fine.

reading: Your Life Path 11 hums like a radio tower under an Aquarius moon. Strange little signals arrive all day: a word you see three times, a smell you have not smelled since you were small, a stranger who seems to know the end of your sentence. Write the oddest one down before bed.

Someone in your orbit is stuck on a problem, and you will see the answer from a sideways angle nobody else thought to look from. Do not just hand it over. Ask the one question that lets them find it themselves. That is your favourite magic trick, helping people level up while they think they did it alone.
nancy.mission: Help someone solve a problem today using only questions, not a single direct suggestion, and see how long you can last.
nancy.omen: A radio or speaker suddenly playing something perfect for the moment. A hunch you had is correct.

together.text: Invent one completely useless gadget together over messages. Give it a name, a slogan and a single button that does something silly. Joel draws the blueprint. Nancy writes the instruction manual. Uranus has expressed interest in a prototype.

game.intro: Aquarius moon, inventor's junk drawer wide open. Build us a gadget out of nothing but little pictures.
game.prompt: An invention the world clearly needs but nobody has bothered to build yet.
